Hi Alyssa / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can size a clean proposal: 

1) Volumes: you mentioned ~6M OCR + 18M shorter inference requests per month (total ~24M tokens/day equivalent on peak). Please confirm average prompt vs completion split — I attached the token profile template for this.
2) Target unit economics: you indicated a target in the ballpark of $200–$300 per 1M tokens for a scaled production tier, with willingness to pilot at higher rates. We captured that as the benchmark to hit.
3) Technical constraints: highest priority is 95p latency < 350ms for short-chat workflows and < 1s for longer doc summarization.
4) Compliance: required SOC2 + VPC/private deployment for PHI-sensitive flows — PA will own the private deployment conversation.

Next steps:
- Alyssa: drop the filled token_profile.xlsx (see attached) and confirm procurement timeline.
- Redwood: I’ll share two pricing scenarios (pilot + scale) with competitive comparison vs common hosts (OpenAI, Anthropic, typical open-hosts) and a simple cost model showing where savings come from.

Attaching: pinebridge_token_profile.xlsx (token bands + latency targets)

Thanks — talk soon.

Alyssa / Tom — attaching a short price-scenario pack and the monthly math you asked for (redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf). Key highlights called out up-front: 

Pilot scenario (3 months) — assume 3M tokens/mo: 
- Redwood hosted (pilot): $/1M = $320 — pilot includes priority burst capacity and observability.
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-ish baseline for comparison): $/1M = $720 (model/throughput premium).
- Anthropic (Claude-like baseline): $/1M = $580.
- Typical open-host median (community-hosted quantized models): $/1M ≈ $220 (note: higher latencies & variability).

Scale scenario (predicted steady-state at 22M tokens/mo): 
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity + caching + model-quantization): effective $/1M ≈ $165–$185 depending on commit length and cache hit rate.
- OpenAI (volume discounts assumed): ~$480–$620/1M at this scale.
- Anthropic: ~$390–$510/1M.
- Open-host median: ~$200/1M but with larger performance variance and fewer SLAs.

Why Redwood closes the gap:
- Automated KV/prefix caching reduces total generated tokens for repeated prompts by 20–40% on typical workflows, improving effective $/1M.
- Continuous batching and worker packing reduces per-token GPU overhead on short requests.
- Ability to pin quantized model variant for Dedicated/private reduces inference cost further for non-LLM-core tasks.

Monthly spend examples (rounded): 
- Pilot (3M/mo): Redwood hosted = $960/mo; OpenAI ≈ $2,160/mo; Open-host median ≈ $660/mo.
- Scale (22M/mo): Redwood Dedicated ≈ $3,630–$4,070/mo; OpenAI ≈ $10,560–$13,640/mo; Open-host median ≈ $4,400/mo.

Assumptions and notes (in attached PDF): token counts are prompt+completion; caching reduces billable tokens where applicable; we modeled a conservative 15% cache hit for scale math. Exact numbers will update when we get the filled token_profile.xlsx you uploaded.

Next asks from Redwood: 
1) Confirm the pilot band (2–3M/mo) or indicate a different starting point.
2) Confirm whether the scale commitment will be 12 or 24 months (affects discounting).
3) Do you want the pilot on Hosted with a path to Dedicated, or start directly on Dedicated Private? (we can price both).

I attached: redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf (4 pages) and the worked monthly math sheet.

If this looks good I can convert the scale scenario into a draft SOW and term sheet for procurement.

Thanks — Tessa
